purpose: Machine-readable inventory of release-lineage and artifact-embedded fields required for reproducibility, integration, and change control.

release_manifest_fields.label: Source checkpoint SHA-256
release_manifest_fields.reason: A deployment artifact does not normally retain the source checkpoint digest.
release_manifest_fields.impact: Without it, the released runtime model cannot be unambiguously traced back to the training checkpoint.
release_manifest_fields.remediation: Record the immutable source checkpoint SHA-256 in the release manifest.

release_manifest_fields.label: Export framework and version
release_manifest_fields.reason: Only a framework family is inferred from artifact evidence; no complete declaration is embedded.
release_manifest_fields.impact: Without an immutable framework identity, converter behavior and operator lowering cannot be reproduced exactly.
release_manifest_fields.remediation: Bind export framework name, package version, source commit, and binary or container digest.

release_manifest_fields.label: Converter version
release_manifest_fields.reason: Artifact evidence identifies a converter family but not an exact converter binary or version.
release_manifest_fields.impact: Without the exact converter build, graph rewrites and numerical contracts cannot be reproduced bit-for-bit.
release_manifest_fields.remediation: Record converter package version, source commit, and binary or container digest.

release_manifest_fields.label: Export configuration
release_manifest_fields.reason: Graph structure does not uniquely recover exporter options.
release_manifest_fields.impact: Options such as keepdims, fused activations, signatures, and optimization passes can change graph structure and delegate partitioning.
release_manifest_fields.remediation: Persist canonical exporter options and their SHA-256.

release_manifest_fields.label: Quantization and calibration configuration
release_manifest_fields.reason: The artifact exposes resulting scales and zero-points, but not the complete recipe or calibration run.
release_manifest_fields.impact: Without the recipe and representative-data binding, quantization drift and calibration regressions cannot be reproduced.
release_manifest_fields.remediation: Record quantizer version, scheme selection, calibration options, and calibration-data binding.

release_manifest_fields.label: Representative dataset ID
release_manifest_fields.reason: Representative calibration data cannot be reconstructed from scales alone.
release_manifest_fields.impact: Without it, calibration ranges and resulting integer contracts cannot be regenerated or audited against dataset changes.
release_manifest_fields.remediation: Record dataset/version ID, selection query, preprocessing revision, and immutable digest.

release_manifest_fields.label: Build pipeline ID
release_manifest_fields.reason: The artifact does not bind the CI/CD execution that produced it.
release_manifest_fields.impact: Without a pipeline run identity, toolchain, environment, and policy evidence cannot be reconstructed.
release_manifest_fields.remediation: Record immutable pipeline or workflow ID and run ID.

release_manifest_fields.label: Software release ID
release_manifest_fields.impact: Without it, a model artifact cannot be tied to the application or firmware release that shipped it.
release_manifest_fields.remediation: Bind the model artifact to the shipping software release ID.

release_manifest_fields.label: Model requirement ID
release_manifest_fields.reason: The artifact does not identify the requirement or acceptance criterion it satisfies.
release_manifest_fields.impact: Without it, audit findings cannot be evaluated against an approved model requirement or acceptance criterion.
release_manifest_fields.remediation: Record the immutable requirement or specification ID and revision.

release_manifest_fields.label: Previous release artifact SHA-256
release_manifest_fields.reason: The artifact does not carry a predecessor link or no-predecessor declaration.
release_manifest_fields.impact: Without an explicit predecessor state, release deltas and change-control lineage cannot be established.
release_manifest_fields.remediation: Record the immediately previous released artifact SHA-256 or an explicit no-predecessor declaration.

artifact_embedded_fields.label: TFLite SignatureDef
artifact_embedded_fields.reason: No typed serving signature is embedded.
artifact_embedded_fields.impact: Without a signature, input/output names alone do not bind a stable callable interface.
artifact_embedded_fields.remediation: Embed and version the serving signature used by the application.

artifact_embedded_fields.label: TFLITE_METADATA
artifact_embedded_fields.reason: No typed model metadata block is embedded.
artifact_embedded_fields.impact: Without typed metadata, tooling cannot reliably recover model identity, process units, associated files, or semantic contracts.
artifact_embedded_fields.remediation: Embed the format-native typed metadata block and bind its schema version.

artifact_embedded_fields.label: Declared minimum runtime version
artifact_embedded_fields.reason: A runtime floor may be derived from op versions, but no minimum is embedded by the producer.
artifact_embedded_fields.impact: Without a declaration, deployment systems cannot compare the producer-stated compatibility floor against analyzer-derived requirements.
artifact_embedded_fields.remediation: Embed the producer-declared minimum runtime version and retain the derived floor separately.

artifact_embedded_fields.label: Model version
artifact_embedded_fields.impact: Without it, identical model names cannot be ordered or linked to release history without relying only on hashes.
artifact_embedded_fields.remediation: Embed a stable model semantic or release version while retaining the artifact SHA-256 as identity.

artifact_embedded_fields.label: Model author
artifact_embedded_fields.impact: Without an author or owning organization, responsibility and maintenance escalation are not machine-readable.
artifact_embedded_fields.remediation: Embed model author or owner identity and an immutable organization reference.

artifact_embedded_fields.label: Model license
artifact_embedded_fields.impact: Without a license declaration, redistribution and deployment permissions cannot be evaluated from the artifact.
artifact_embedded_fields.remediation: Embed an SPDX license identifier or a cryptographically bound license reference.

artifact_embedded_fields.label: Output label or semantic map
artifact_embedded_fields.reason: No machine-verified output-0 label or semantic mapping is embedded.
artifact_embedded_fields.impact: Without it, class indices or output tensors cannot be mapped to application meaning reproducibly.
artifact_embedded_fields.remediation: Embed and hash the output label map or typed postprocessing contract.

artifact_embedded_fields.label: Preprocessing contract
artifact_embedded_fields.reason: Static analysis derives exact realizability candidates, but the artifact does not select or document the production implementation.
artifact_embedded_fields.impact: Without it, a numerically valid model can silently receive application inputs under an incompatible normalization or channel-order contract.
artifact_embedded_fields.remediation: Embed the preprocessing contract and bind the production implementation SHA-256.

related_documents.integrity_binding: The evidence BOM hashes this specification; the complete ZIP member set is bound by deepbom_contract_pack_manifest.json.

rulepack_hash_basis: scripts/generate-xnnpack-delegate-rulepack.mjs (XNNPACK delegate rule generator and source digest contract)
src/lib.rs (target profiles and XNNPACK support rules)
src/kernel_witness.rs (exact quantized kernel extremum witness solver)
web/lib/kernel-witness.js (independent browser kernel witness validator and viewer)
web/lib/kernel-witness-worker.js (independent browser kernel witness verification worker)
src/channel_vitality.rs (exact monotone quantized channel vitality solver)
web/lib/channel-vitality.js (independent browser channel vitality validator and viewer)
web/lib/channel-vitality-worker.js (independent browser channel vitality verification worker)
web/lib/rounding-equivalence.js (independent browser rounding equivalence validator and viewer)
web/lib/rounding-equivalence-worker.js (independent browser rounding equivalence verification worker)
src/numerical_abi_propagation.rs (exact numerical ABI graph propagation solver)
web/lib/numerical-abi-propagation.js (independent browser numerical ABI propagation validator)
web/lib/numerical-abi-propagation-viewer.js (numerical ABI propagation atlas viewer and export renderer)
scripts/generate-ort-rulepack.mjs (pinned ORT rule generator and source digest contract)
web/lib/xnnpack-selector-evidence.js (public XNNPACK evidence identity and arithmetic adapter)
web/lib/ort-compatibility-evidence.js (public ORT evidence identity and conservation adapter)
protected authenticated rule source set (3 owners; implementation paths withheld; included in RULEPACK_SHA256)

interpretation_boundary: Missing means not found in the artifact or supplied release context, not proof that the organization lacks the information. Partial preserves artifact-derived evidence without promoting it to a producer declaration.
